about: results per value of a field, list items counted one by one
sql: SELECT j.value, count(*) FROM (SELECT o.id FROM fts CROSS JOIN search_text st ON st.doc = fts.rowid CROSS JOIN objects o ON o.id = st.object_id WHERE fts MATCH ? AND o.deleted_at IS NULL) q JOIN objects p ON p.id = q.id, json_each(CASE WHEN json_type(p.props_json, ?) = 'array' THEN json_extract(p.props_json, ?) ELSE json_array(json_extract(p.props_json, ?)) END) j WHERE j.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY j.value ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 50
